# Wenaili - Shanghai Wenaili Information Technology Co., Ltd.

> Wenaili (奈李AI物流实验室 / 上海奈李信息技术有限公司) is a digital marketing and AI adoption agency specialized in the freight forwarding and international logistics industry. We provide full-service marketing managed operations for freight forwarders: AI adoption, GEO optimization, website development, content marketing, and lead generation. 10 years of experience in freight & logistics digital marketing. 10年专注货代物流数字化营销与AI落地，货代市场部全案代运营。

## Company

- [About Wenaili](https://www.wenaili.com/aboutus): 上海奈李信息技术有限公司（Wenaili），10年专注货代物流行业数字化营销与品牌建设，货代市场部及技术部代运营服务商

- [Marketing Managed Operations](https://www.wenaili.com/services/marketing): 货代市场部代运营 - 市场策划、品牌推广、获客转化
